scenes.voice: Sudden traffic se app crash ho raha hai? Jaaniye massive systems kaise survive karte hain.
scenes.headline: APP *CRASHING* FROM TRAFFIC?
scenes.subtitle: System scaling explained

scenes.voice: Sabse pehle, Load Balancer ek traffic cop ki tarah aakar, incoming users ko multiple servers par evenly distribute karta hai.
scenes.headline: THE *LOAD* BALANCER

scenes.voice: Ek bada supercomputer kharidne ke bajay, woh kai chhote servers add karte hain. Ise Horizontal Scaling kehte hain.
scenes.headline: SCALE *OUT* NOT UP

scenes.voice: Next hai caching. Woh frequent requests ko instant access ke liye memory databases mein store karte hain, taaki main database par load na pade.
scenes.headline: CACHE FOR *SPEED*

scenes.voice: Heavy background jobs hain? Unhe message queue mein bhej dein taaki app slow hue bina baad mein process ho sakein.
scenes.headline: USE *MESSAGE* QUEUES

scenes.voice: System design ke basics master karein aur sudden traffic se app crash hona rokein!
scenes.headline: APP *CRASHING* FROM TRAFFIC?
